title: Zoje ZJ2845-BD-D3-3/02
subtitle: 2-Needle Direct-Drive Micro-Oil Lockstitch Machine

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The ZJ2845-BD is a 2-needle lockstitch machine with a built-in direct-drive AC servo motor, designed for light-to-medium material sewing. The -BD-D3-3/02 suffix indicates direct-drive (-BD), micro-oil lubrication (-D3), and 3/02 variant.
applications: Twin-needle decorative stitching on shirts, blouses, trousers
Production lines with auto thread trimmer and energy-saving servo motor
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing, shirt production, light industrial textile assembly

overviewDescription: Made by Zoje (Zhejiang, China). Part of the ZJ2845/2875 series of 2-needle lockstitch machines. The `-BD` suffix denotes direct-drive (built-in servo), D3 indicates micro-oil lubrication system. The ManualsLib listing of the operation manual (77 pages) is the canonical reference for this family.

ZJ2845 (variants: ZJ2842, ZJ2845, ZJ2872, ZJ2875; -BD = direct-drive; -D3 = micro-oil)
